verdict.rationale: RUN's own RUN & DONE feature puts recurring payroll "on autopilot," and pay is deposited automatically on payday, so one fixed workflow does run unattended in the background. That is a single prebuilt payroll automation, not a way for users to define their own background automations. API Central is a developer building block and AI error flagging is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, triggers and schedules beyond payroll, agentic or AI-driven autonomous actions, detailed documentation and independent corroboration of RUN & DONE behavior.
